metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.7 · 2015 · Murder, She Baked: A Chocolate Chip Cookie Mystery
metas.description: A baker in small-town Minnesota turns amateur sleuth after finding her friend and delivery driver shot to death behind her shop.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.8 · 2015 · Murder, She Baked: A Plum Pudding Mystery
metas.description: At Christmas season, Hannah comes for a check for goods from her bakery/cafe and finds Larry shot dead. Her detective friend tells her in vain to stay out of the investigation. The "ex wife" isn't the only suspect.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.9 · 2016 · Murder, She Baked: A Peach Cobbler Mystery
metas.description: Once again Hannah is plummeted into a murder mystery by finding the dead body of her competitor. But this time she's the one accused of murder over peach cobbler.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.8 · 2016 · Murder, She Baked: A Deadly Recipe
metas.description: Bakery owner Hannah and her sister find the sheriff's body. Hannah promises cop detective wannabe boyfriend not to get involved, but her sister's husband is running at the sheriff election making him prime suspect and suspended.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.8 · 2017 · Murder, She Baked: Just Desserts
metas.description: Hannah investigates the murder of a fellow bake-off judge.
